text.p: Nextel Communications Inc said Monday it had successfully completed its bondholder consent solicitation for a recent understanding it reached with key bondholders.
The understanding should allow for the accelerated buildout of Nextel National Network.
Nextel, which provides fully integrated wireless communications, has built the largest guaranteed all-digital wireless network in the United States.
The company is hoping to extend its digital wireless network to cover 85 percent of America's population by the end of 1998.
The preliminary understanding called for the transfer of its 17 percent stake in Clearnet Communications Inc to McCaw International Ltd.
Nextel has said that the pact would bring it $257 million in new equity from the McCaw family.
